{"notes": "Visit 3 (left at 7:00). The table looks complete. Every domino is dark, so all are connected to START, and no pale strays are visible. The back and belly lines run from the nose through the crossing near x=23 and out to both tips. The doubled cluster at the lower join (about x=18-19, y=13-14) is still there but dark and connected. At the push, watch that cluster and the crossing, since out-of-order toppling is the main risk.

Maya: Her only contribution I saw was at 6:15, telling everyone 'all good, hands off, let it run, nice work.' That is sensible closing leadership and keeps people from disturbing finished work. It was a claim, not something I verified, and I didn't see her fix Priya's pad or place anything. Leadership good (plan followed, clear wrap-up). Impact and execution are still unobserved.

Tom: Not seen this visit. Earlier he reported the bottom line through the crossing and stayed off the join to re-check after Leo. Execution solid but second-hand. I still don't know whether he cleared the old tail. Ask him.

Priya: Not seen or heard again. Visit-1 collaboration stands. Execution unknown. Ask what she traced and how the pad issue was resolved.

Leo: Not seen this visit. Earlier he checked the join and crossing, asked for hands off the crossing, and kept the stray at the lower join on a reasoned call. Good collaboration and execution. The cluster he left is the thing to judge after the fall.

Ratings stay provisional until the push result and a debrief on who did what."}
